title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong follows Hornet, princess-protector of Hallownest, after she is captured and taken to the unfamiliar kingdom of Pharloom. Rather than descending through a ruined realm, Hornet's pilgrimage pushes upward toward the kingdom's shining citadel. Her movement is faster and more acrobatic than the Knight's, with diagonal attacks, mantling, sprinting and silk-powered abilities. Tools can be crafted and equipped through crest systems, while quests, merchants and settlements give the world a more explicit social structure. Team Cherry advertises more than 200 enemies and more than 40 bosses, plus a Steel Soul challenge mode and a full orchestral score by Christopher Larkin.

description_short: A fast, acrobatic metroidvania starring Hornet as she ascends through Pharloom, with crafted tools, quests, more than 200 enemies and more than 40 bosses, enhanced on Nintendo Switch 2.
description_ar: تكملة Hollow Knight وبطلتها Hornet في مملكة Pharloom. تتميز بحركة أسرع وقتال يعتمد على الإبرة والحرير وTools قابلة للصناعة وQuests وأكثر من 200 عدو وأكثر من 40 Boss، إضافة إلى Steel Soul Mode.
nintendoNotes: Nintendo lists the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition as an enhanced version with higher resolution, improved frame rates and additional effects. The game is single-player and supports Simplified Chinese. No verified direct Full Wrap image was found during this extraction, so 3D texture fields are intentionally blank.
switch2Features: Improved frame rates, including high-refresh-rate presentation in supported modes.
Additional visual effects in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.
tagline: Ascend through the haunted kingdom of Pharloom as Hornet, mastering acrobatic combat, silk abilities, crafted tools and a vast web of quests.
fitFor: Players who enjoy exploration-driven metroidvania worlds with hidden routes, upgrades and challenging bosses.
Players who want faster, more acrobatic combat than the original Hollow Knight.
Nintendo Switch 2 owners who want the enhanced version with higher resolution, improved frame rates and additional effects.
notFitFor: Players who strongly prefer linear progression and constant objective markers.
Players who dislike demanding boss fights, repeated attempts and exploration without heavy hand-holding.
Players looking for multiplayer or cooperative play; the adventure is single-player.

gameplayPillars.title: Acrobatic Needle Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Hornet fights with a needle and silk-based techniques, combining aerial movement, fast repositioning, diagonal attacks and healing/ability management.

gameplayPillars.title: Ascend Through Pharloom
gameplayPillars.description: Explore an interconnected kingdom built around vertical progression, environmental secrets, shortcuts, settlements and increasingly dangerous regions.

gameplayPillars.title: Tools, Crests and Quests
gameplayPillars.description: Craft and equip tools, tune loadouts through crests, meet inhabitants and complete quests while uncovering the kingdom’s history.

worldSummary: Pharloom is a vast insect kingdom structured as an upward pilgrimage. Hornet moves through mossy grottos, coral-like forests, industrial settlements, gilded cities and misted regions while climbing toward the shining Citadel. Settlements, merchants, quest givers and hidden paths give the kingdom a stronger social structure than Hallownest while retaining interconnected metroidvania exploration.

storyChapters.title: Captured and Taken to Pharloom
storyChapters.body: Hornet is captured and carried to an unfamiliar kingdom. After escaping, she begins an upward journey through Pharloom toward the Citadel.

storyChapters.title: The Pilgrimage Upward
storyChapters.body: The route expands through varied regions, settlements and dangerous territories as Hornet gathers new tools, abilities and information about the forces shaping the kingdom.

storyChapters.title: Toward the Citadel
storyChapters.body: Later progression focuses on increasingly difficult traversal, bosses and revelations surrounding the kingdom’s peak, presented here without endgame spoilers.

features: Explore Pharloom, a new insect kingdom built around vertical ascent, hidden routes and interconnected regions.
Hornet uses fast acrobatic movement, aerial attacks and silk-based abilities that make traversal and combat more agile than Hollow Knight.
A broad tool system lets Hornet craft and equip offensive, defensive and utility tools for different situations.
Quest-style objectives give structured reasons to revisit settlements, characters and previously explored regions.
Boss encounters emphasize mobility, pattern reading and aggressive counterplay.
Christopher Larkin returns with an orchestral score written specifically for Pharloom and Hornet’s journey.
perfNotes: Switch 2 provides a clean high-frame-rate presentation. Team Cherry/Nintendo do not publish one universal fixed native resolution number on the store page, so an exact render resolution is not invented.

handheld.notes: Switch 2 handheld runs at 1080p up to 120 FPS in the performance mode.

faq.q: Is Hollow Knight: Silksong a direct sequel to Hollow Knight?
faq.a: Yes. It follows Hornet in the new kingdom of Pharloom and builds on the exploration and combat structure of Hollow Knight with a faster protagonist and new systems.

faq.q: What is improved on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Nintendo specifically lists higher resolution, improved frame rates and additional effects for the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.
No. The Nintendo release is a single-player adventure.

verdictSummary:
Score note: 9.4/10 is a direct normalization of the current 94/100 Metacritic aggregate for the Nintendo listing; it is not a separately invented store rating.

Silksong expands the Hollow Knight formula around Hornet’s speed and mobility, a new upward-structured kingdom, crafted tools and a large enemy/boss roster. The Switch 2 Edition is especially attractive for players who want the enhanced Nintendo presentation.
verdictPros: Fast, expressive movement and combat built around Hornet.
Large interconnected world with strong visual variety and exploration depth.
Switch 2 enhancements improve presentation without changing the core game.
verdictCons: High difficulty can be demanding for players who prefer relaxed progression.
Exploration-heavy structure can require backtracking and self-directed navigation.
Single-player only; there is no cooperative or competitive mode.

OpenCritic aggregate recorded at 91/100. Where OpenCritic groups platforms, this value represents the published aggregate rather than a fabricated platform-specific score.
Current Metacritic user score shown with the listing: 8.9/10. User scores can change over time as additional ratings are submitted.

patchNotes.body: Team Cherry’s fourth major patch introduced the Team Cart Fix Simplified Chinese translation, moved controller handling to Unity’s newer Input System, added controller-support improvements and delivered another broad bug-fix pass. Team Cherry later confirmed the patch live on all platforms.
